up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1140846. Return their ChEMBL IDs, names (pref_name), max phase, molecule type (structure_type), and canonical SMILES. Join the document to the compound records via the record_id, then join to the molecule dictionary for metadata and to compound_structures for the SMILES. Do not apply any additional filters on assays, confidence scores, or target types. Return all matching rows without ranking or limits.
sql: SELECT md.molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.structure_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140846'
